Prions are very scary. Prion, literally meaning Protein Infection. Not a bacteria, not a virus. Just a protein, and yet it's infectious and spreads to other nearby proteins. Mad Cow, Creutzfeldt–Jakob disease, call it what you want. A protein begins to fold incorrectly, and that somehow begins to spread to the neighboring proteins. Prions cannot be cooked away, frozen away, sterilized away, boiled away. Literally the proteins have to be rendered 100% to ash. Observed long ago in some cannibalistic tribes on Papua New Guinea, in tribes that would consume the brains of elders, believing it would help to pass on their knowledge. Spread into cow populations when butchered cows were being used to add proteins to cattle feed, when spinal and stem tissue would end up in the mix, and then again, when the cow was butchered, making some those infected proteins end up in the hamburger eaten by regular folks. Progressed fast in some, slow in others, and by the time it was discovered, who knows how many were infected before the process of feeding cows to cows ended.
